rule: Feedback carries hypotheses, constraints and experiments; shared ancestry is not independent evidence and no branch promotion occurs from receipt repetition.

items: Preserve trajectory formation != exit/readout policy as an explicit experimental factor for recurrent FRANK research.
Treat residual-estimator calibration and false-halt regret as cross-branch research variables, not merely controller implementation details.
Convergence semantics are tightened: low residual alone cannot mint fixed-point convergence; persistent low state_delta and low residual are jointly required in H1 quality-gate v0.3.
Keep generic low-error stopping semantically distinct from fixed-point convergence if a future controller needs that behavior.
Test whether ignition/re-entry changes residual calibration or state-delta trajectories; do not let salience or broadcast alone imply convergence.
Use truthful, shuffled and no-reentry matched traces when measuring halt quality.
Do not interpret recurrence stability or calibrated stopping as emergence; retain lesion/rescue and higher-order causal tests separately.
Include stopping-policy identity and trajectory/readout configuration in intervention provenance.
H2 must reproduce the corrected convergence contract and policy/receipt identity; this is a semantic differential gate, not a reason to redesign syntax.
Represent residual estimator identity/version, uncertainty, age, low-delta streak and distinct halt reasons in the existing typed contract.
When readout quality is uncertain, preserve alternative continuation/route hypotheses instead of collapsing uncertainty into convergence.
Test whether alternate-route preservation reduces false halt without destabilizing healthy convergence.
Graph projections may expose loop state_delta, residual and readout-quality provenance, but activation/topology must not infer convergence truth.
Bind loop observations to state epoch and policy/readout receipt identity.
Persist time-aligned raw readout fields and eventual outcomes so residual calibration and false-halt regret can be reconstructed.
Preserve estimator/version/policy identity and truthful/shuffled/no-reentry intervention labels for replay.
Add Ubuntu/replay regressions for high-delta+low-residual, transient low-delta, low-delta+high-residual and genuine convergence.
Add shadow residual-calibration benchmark and fixed-budget/post-hoc/controller-coupled recurrence comparison before controller promotion.
